name: PasswordField
summary: A password field with a show/hide control that announces what it does.

a11y.nota: o botão anuncia pelo rótulo, que muda com o estado; sem aria-pressed, para o leitor de tela não dizer a mesma coisa duas vezes
a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 2026-08-27 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). Nothing was confirmed by the snapshot: the focus lands on a text input, where Space types a character and every printable key changes the value — the probe excludes that case (digitaTexto) rather than accusing a correct ficha. Declared and not confirmed in this snapshot: Enter, Space. Absence of an observable change does not prove absence of effect — a generic DOM snapshot can prove a key does something, never that it does not.

props.name: size
props.description: The system's size step. It also picks the size of the show/hide button, so the two never disagree.

props.name: defaultVisible
props.description: Starts with the password showing. Uncontrolled — the component owns the state from there, because the toggle is a gesture, not application state.
